_notes.about: Lesson 14 in English (en and en-GB, which has its own keyboard). From the lesson plan "Typing Game Sentence Bank: Lessons 2-13". The id is the lesson's scoreboard: never change it.
_notes.intro: Page 1, before the keys: anything that doesn't fit on Page 2 (lesson 1: "what is touch typing?"). Leave it out and the lesson starts at the new keys. "title" and "paragraphs"; in a paragraph, **bold** and [E] (a key drawn as a key: [space], [;], [Tab] ...). "picture": "hands" (the default: the hands over the lesson's keyboard), "none", or a picture file in images/ (with "pictureAlt", what it shows). With "hands": "reach" sends fingers to keys ({"lm": "e", "rm": "i"}: lp lr lm li, rp rr rm ri; keys "e", ";", "ShiftL", "ShiftR" ...; the others stay home), and "keys" says which keys show: "letters" (the default), "shift", "symbols" or "all".
_notes.hideHand: "left", "right" or "none": that hand isn't drawn on Page 2, and its column of new keys isn't listed.
_notes.sentenceLists: Up to four lists: name (shown above the typing box, or ""), count (how many to pick at random each attempt; 0 = unused) and sentences. Use real words, and only keys taught so far. Lesson 1 has no end mark because ";" hasn't been taught. Write ⇥ for the Tab key and ↵ for Enter.
_notes.changes: In a sentence, {typed>fixed} is a planned change: the learner types the first word, deletes back with Backspace to what the two words share, and types the rest. Only the sentence up to the next change shows, with a note above the typing saying what to do.
_notes.allowBackspace: true: Backspace works in this lesson. With an accuracy pass mark of 100 (edugame.json, the package's settings) every mistake must be fixed before the sentence ends.

title: Lesson 14: Backspace

intro.title: Fixing mistakes: Backspace
paragraphs: [Backspace] deletes the last letter you typed. Press it with your right little finger: reach up and to the right from [;], then come straight back.
In this lesson you'll type a word, then change it: delete back to the letter that changes, and type the right letters. A note above the typing tells you what to do.
Every mistake must be fixed before you go on, so this lesson needs **100% accuracy**.

advice: [Backspace] is at the right end of the number row. Reach up with your right little finger, press it, and come back to [;].
Each press deletes one letter. To change a letter at the start or in the middle of a word, delete back to it, then type the rest of the word again.
Keep your eyes on the screen: the note shows how many times to press [Backspace].
